The '''''Hunter''-class starfighter''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] designed for interplanetary flight. They were heavily armed and the fastest, most maneuverable ships used by the [[Je'daii Order]] in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]]. [[Je'daii Ranger]]s often customized these ships.
